script.spoken: It derailed and exploded, and forty seven people were killed. In the middle of the night, a runaway oil train rolled into a Quebec town. Nobody was aboard. It had been parked uphill with too few handbrakes applied. A fire broke out on the locomotive. When the engine was shut down, its air brakes slowly released. The train began rolling down toward the town. Canada tightened rules for securing trains and building tank cars.
